LanguageData.USAC_MICLIC_Towed.label: towed mineclearing line
LanguageData.USAC_MICLIC_Towed.description: Launch a rocket trailing a continuous demolition cable. On impact the cable detonates along its whole length, clearing any mines beneath it.
LanguageData.USAC_MineclearingShovel.label: mineclearing shovel
LanguageData.USAC_MineclearingShovel.description: The mech charges to the target position, setting off two powerful fan-shaped blasts along the way to clear mines and obstacles.
